notes: Asked for by the founder 2026-09-16 during the items 2-8 walk, after the free tier's one-set-per-campaign limit stopped Act 3. Two decisions already taken by the founder: the switch governs RESTRICTIONS ONLY and never billing; plan and pricing pages stay reachable while it is off, with the upgrade prompts hidden. Ships ON, so applying it changes nothing until somebody flips it. Production-impacting: migration + Render + Vercel + brand OTA; explicit go required.

build.migration: 185_subscriptions_master_switch.sql — one platform_settings row, value 1 (ON). No schema change.
backend: services/platformSettings.service.js — the key, declared FIRST so it leads the admin page; kind: "switch" travels in the payload
services/entitlements.service.js — plansEnforced() read once, honoured in getEntitlements (and so in quotaFor/configFor) and short-circuited in hasFeature; _unrestricted() is the off answer
controllers/subscription.controller.js — plans_enforced on the plan payload and the quota preflight
web: admin/settings/platform — a 0/1 setting draws as a switch; turning the master switch OFF asks first; amber banner while off; the audit line reads "on → off"
components/PlansOffBanner.js on admin Subscriptions, Pricing → Tiers and Pricing → Features — all three stay fully editable
dashboard/settings/subscription — while off, the usage meters become one line and every other tier's Choose button reads "Not needed right now". The plan, its price and the next charge stay.
build.mobile: NOTHING. There is no plan, tier or quota screen in the brand app — checked, not assumed. M6 is built on the website; see 06-diff/notes.md.
build.tests: backend/tests/subscriptions-master-switch.test.js — 14 tests over expected outputs 1-21, each run with the switch on AND off. Includes: a missing row enforces, a failing read enforces, OFF is never narrower than ON across the whole catalogue, and billing is byte-identical across a flip.
build.regression: Backend suite 222 failed / 1084 passed / 1306 vs a measured HEAD baseline of 222 failed / 1070 passed / 1292 — the 14 new tests, nothing else moved. 46 failing suites before and after. brand-web `next build` exits 0.
build.one_existing_test_updated: item6-negotiation.test.js check 29 asserted the exact key list and settings[0] on the platform-settings screen. The switch now leads that list, so the assertion names negotiation_rounds instead of indexing position 0, and the new key is in the expected list. Intent unchanged.
build.found_and_scoped_out: The test harness truncates the features catalogue and never reseeds it, so every quota reads null and the middleware passes — meaning every existing "this plan limit blocks" assertion is unproven. Reseeding it globally turns 23 currently-green tests red. Measured, reverted, and written up in 05-impact.md as its own contract: "the quota tests do not test quotas".
build.note: Built and certified, NOT deployed. Needs migration 185 + push (Render + Vercel). No OTA — nothing in the mobile apps changed.
